notes: Nonnumeric input reaches C's exact safety response across the focused seed matrix (R1/R2/R5e).
A VNUM outside every zone reaches C's unknown-zone response and leaves no editor reservation (R1/R2/R4/R5e).
An empty argument selects the actor's current room and emits the room-scoped ZEDIT menu (R1/R2/R5e).
A valid room enters the descriptor-owned editor and later input routes through CON_ZEDIT (R1/R2/R4/R5e).
Invalid main-menu input preserves C's contiguous redraw bytes (R1/R2/R5e).
Immortal top editing uses C's last-zone 32000 clamp or next-zone boundary and only dirties changed values (R1/R4/R5e).
Lifespan/reset prompts, numeric gates, and header dirty state match C (R1/R2/R4/R5e).
New-command accepts the terminator position and inserts literal N before the command quiz (R1/R2/R5e).
Numeric delete input dirties the zone even when the strict delete range rejects the index (R1/R4/R5e).
Command type and dependent-command quiz preserve the C position-zero exception and working-copy save path (R1/R2/R4/R5e).
The D arg2 gate accepts the terminal direction index exactly as C does, including its sentinel rendering path (R1/R4/R5e).
L loop finish stores -1 and returns directly to the main menu, while loop start asks for a positive repeat count (R1/R2/R5e).
The first save prompt, retry prompt, and in-memory save bytes match C exactly (R1/R2/R5e).
ZEDIT menu color escapes are compared raw with ANSI enabled (R1/R5a).
With color disabled every menu byte is plain; keep-ansi proves no escapes are invented (R1/R4).
The registered command carries C's POS_DEAD and LVL_IMMORT entry gate (R1/R2/R5e).
The per-room duplicate reservation refuses a second editor and is released by clean cleanup (R1/R3/R5e).
Setup uses -1/VNUM carry while save uses -2/rnum carry; stale matched star commands are not re-added, and disk bytes use parser VNUM identity (R1/R3/R4/R5e).
New-zone files, typo-preserving templates, ordered indexes, and in-memory insertion match C's artifacts (R1/R4/R5e).
